+@pytest.mark.parametrize('name, expected_min, expected_max',
+                         [('n', 1, 2), ('name', 'Z', 'a')])
+def test_min_max_attribute_and_case_sensitive(name, expected_min, expected_max):
+    values = [{'name': 'a', 'n': 2}, {'name': 'Z', 'n': 1}]
+    assert ms.min(env, values, attribute=name, case_sensitive=True) == next(v for v in values if v[name] == expected_min)
+    assert ms.max(env, values, attribute=name, case_sensitive=True) == next(v for v in values if v[name] == expected_max)
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('filter_name, expected', [('min', 'small'), ('max', 'large')])
+def test_min_max_in_template(filter_name, expected):
+    template_env = Environment()
+    template_env.filters[filter_name] = ms.FilterModule().filters()[filter_name]
+    template = template_env.from_string("{{ (values | %s(attribute='block_total'))['name'] }}" % filter_name)
+    values = [{'name': 'small', 'block_total': 10}, {'name': 'large', 'block_total': 20}]
+    assert template.render(values=values) == expected

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('filter_name, available, jinja_filter',
+                         [('min', 'HAS_MIN', 'do_min'), ('max', 'HAS_MAX', 'do_max')])
+def test_min_max_forward_all_keywords(monkeypatch, filter_name, available, jinja_filter):

+
+    def filter_stub(environment, values, **kwargs):

+    monkeypatch.setattr(ms, available, True)

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('filter_name, available, expected',
